title: scripts/pm grew by about 7,900 lines in a week while the skill text is ratcheted: census the half-state rows and fleet tools by reader, delete what nobody reads, and make the next 30 days net-negative
body:
director#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg12BtjFc5rHp7YD1J

**Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer set.** The director's project assessment proposed 「给 `scripts/pm` 也加一个净增上限,或者每季度定一个删减目标」; the maintainer answered 「同意」. This card takes the deletion target, which adds no gate. A net-growth ceiling is a ratchet, and per `instrument-discipline.md` a ratchet needs the maintainer to name it on the card; ⛔ it is not in scope unless the maintainer writes that here. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` seat.

## Measured (`origin/main`, 2026-11-02)

| reading | value |
|:--|--:|
| `scripts/pm/**/*.mjs` total lines | 139,077 |
| `check-half-states.mjs` | 36,785 |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs` + its self-test | 16,494 + 14,191 |
| `check-governed-merges.mjs` | 7,140 |
| net lines added to `scripts/pm` 2026-10-26 → 11-02 | +7,912 (+10,325 / −2,413) |
| same window, `.claude/` · `AGENTS.md` | +133 · −67 |

Governing text: `instrument-discipline.md` 「工具位只有一个,先花在删除上」 and 「只报告的仪器 … 它的在途工作只有删除」; the north star's 「新增门禁默认否」.

## Ask

1. Census `check-half-states.mjs` row by row: its named reader, and whether any seat cited that row in a comment in the last 30 days (search the row id). List rows with no reader or no citation.
2. The same census for each `scripts/pm` tool: which skill text or workflow invokes it.
3. Delete the rows and tools with no reader, in PRs of one family each, with their self-test cases; ⛔ no behaviour change in the rows that stay.
4. Report on this card the 30-day net line change of `scripts/pm` at the end; the target is net-negative.

## Done when

The census is on this card, the deletion PRs have merged, and `scripts/pm`'s net change over the 30 days after this card's filing is below zero.
